description:
Consider a process for purchasing items from an online shop.
The user starts an order by logging in to their account.
Then, the user simultaneously selects the items to purchase and sets a payment method.
Afterward, the user either pays or completes an installment agreement.
After selecting the items, the user chooses between multiple options for a free reward.
Since the reward value depends on the purchase value, this step is done after selecting the items, but it is independent of the payment activities.
Finally, the items are delivered.
The user has the right to return items for exchange.
Every time items are returned, a new delivery is made.

                  id="Definitions_OnlineShop"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderSubmission" name="Order submission" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Items returned for exchange" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Delivery" />

                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Return" />

                      sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Event_DeliveryReceived"

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose a free reward" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Merge payment options" gatewayDirection="Converging" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SelectionsJoin" name="Selections complete" gatewayDirection="Converging" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryReceived" name="Receive delivery">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Delivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnDecision" name="Return items for exchange?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange" messageRef="Message_Return" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ItemsKept" name="Items kept" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderInitiated" targetRef="Task_LogIn" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_5" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionsJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_6" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_7" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_8" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_Pay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_9" name="Installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_10" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_11" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_13" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_14" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Event_DeliveryReceived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_15" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_16" name="Return for exchange" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_17" name="Do not return" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" targetRef="End_ItemsKept" />

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="Deliver items" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission" />

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Returned items received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DeliveryCompleted" name="Delivery completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_2" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_3" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="End_DeliveryCompleted" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
